time.common:timeRepresentativenessDescription: Average waste composition from literature references. Transfer coefficients from prospective, tailings-specific model.

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Mechanically stable tailings impoundment. Spontaneous renaturation after closure.

# Included processes
Waste-specific short- and long-term emissions to ground water from tailings impoundment leachate. Land transformation and occupation.

dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.samplingProcedure: Tailings model based on observed leachate concentrations in literature. Extrapolated to 60'000 years heeding chemical characteristics. Initial waste composition from various literature sources.

review.common:reviewDetails: Proof reading validation: passed; Other validation: none;

publicationAndOwnership.common:accessRestrictions: All information can be accessed by everybody.
